errors.text_span: and displays percentage labels outside the slices for the "Medium", "Very easy", "Very hard", and "Easy" categories
errors.evidence: This statement incorrectly implies that only four of the five categories have percentage labels. In the figure, all five categories, including "Hard", have percentage labels displayed near their respective slices.

errors.text_span: The slices are arranged in a clockwise order, starting with "Medium" and followed by "Hard", "Easy", "Very hard", and "Very easy"
errors.evidence: The description of the clockwise arrangement of slices is incorrect. Following "Medium" in a clockwise direction is "Very easy", not "Hard" as stated. The actual clockwise order starting from the top is: Very easy, Very hard, Easy, Hard, Medium.
The description fails to mention that the legend provides the raw counts for each difficulty category (e.g., Medium (725,892), Hard (360,137), etc.).
